name: Almea
source:
She is from the ogre race. Despite her appearance, she is a powerful woman. She is one of the former demon king's lieutenants.

She has a rough and random personality, but she is surprisingly intelligent. She has a dependable, sisterly side to her.

She has two horns on her forehead, a characteristic of an ogre.

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/kusozako.html]official site[/url]]
